title: Deployed mom surprises kids with early return
description:
It was the scheduled date night spaghetti dinner at the School Age Center.

Elijah and Londyn Gardner were in for a big surprise, however.

Their mother, Air Force Tech Sgt. LaDonna Gardner, had returned after seven months deployed in Qatar. Her son and daughter didn’t think she would be back until Feb. 14 but she surprised them at the center’s Date Night With Your Child event Feb. 11.
